headline: Binance puts hack at about $6.3 billion

scenes.vo: Binance now says about six point three billion dollars was taken in this week's hack, the largest crypto theft on record. Here's what changed.
Binance says its first findings point to a compromised engineer's laptop, with no sign that wallet keys leaked. About three billion dollars has been frozen. Deposits and withdrawals are still paused.
Here's why traders are watching it. Binance says it will cover all losses from its safety fund and company money, and says user funds are safe.
The catch. Research firms T R M Labs and Chainalysis link the attack to North Korean hackers. Bitcoin dipped near seventy six thousand dollars as traders were forced out.
Here's what happens next. Watch for when withdrawals reopen, Binance's promised post mortem, and its updated proof of reserves.
